description: Which wp-mcp tools the phase 3 builder may call, and what n8n must check before/after each call. wp-mcp itself already enforces WordPress capabilities and idempotency (see wp-mcp/docs/posts-media-mcp-tools.md); this policy is the orchestration-side boundary on top of that.

upsert_post.purpose: Create or update one page/post per artifact_key, idempotently.

list_categories.purpose: Discover existing taxonomy before creating one.

create_category.purpose: Create a taxonomy term referenced by content.

get_elementor_document.purpose: Read the imported Elementor document and revision before semantic changes.

apply_elementor_design_system.purpose: Apply validated global colors, typography, and container width through Elementor APIs.

replace_kit_content.purpose: Replace explicitly mapped semantic fields through the guarded Elementor patch engine.

ensure_pages_and_menu.purpose: Create missing draft pages and navigation entries idempotently.

inspect_elementor_build.purpose: Read-only inspection for editability, placeholders, unsafe or unavailable widgets.

regenerate_elementor_css.purpose: Regenerate Elementor CSS after validated mutations.

rollback_elementor_snapshot.purpose: Restore an explicitly selected Elementor snapshot after a failed page mutation.

denied_tools_note: Everything not listed in allowed_tools is denied by default -- notably delete_post, WooCommerce mutations outside its separate branch, raw Elementor document creation, dangerous widgets, and upload_media until media provenance is validated.

publication_gate.rule: If any proposed artifact's content matches a placeholder pattern, its status is forced to draft regardless of what the agent requested -- unresolved placeholders are never publishable.
